neighbours.label: country-wide spatial extent: ' nationwide' or 'around / across the country' closing a statement about distribution (weaker on region names such as Anatolia, northern Syria)
fire: The retailer runs a dozen warehouses and offers next-day delivery nationwide, even in rural areas.
The charity trains volunteers in first aid and now has chapters nationwide, most of them in small towns.
After the ruling, similar lawsuits were filed nationwide by parents and school boards.
The survey tracks the price of bread, milk and fuel in markets around the country, month by month.
The ministry has shipped two million textbooks to primary schools around the country, with more to come.
Founded in a garage, the brewery today sells its beer in shops nationwide and in parts of Canada.
The outbreak began in the capital, and within weeks cases were being reported around the country, mostly among children.
With a head office in Leeds and repair depots nationwide, the firm promises a same-day visit.

notes: Card: ' country' x7 after 'around/across the', ' nationwide', plus Anatolia and Syria. Probes: nationwide 0.34-0.77, 'around the country' 0.54 in a long sentence but 0.12 in a short one, 'across the country' 0.27, 'downtown' 0.23, country as a state 0.03. Near misses keep ' country' as a political entity or swap in a local place.
